svg.text: The panel's charge pump needs VBAT 3.5–4.2 V (4.5 V max), so it runs from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cell through Q1, switched by GPIO10. Below ~3.5 V cell the panel dims.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Firmware must send 8D 14 (charge pump on); goggl1's SSD1309 code does not.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: IREF: 620k is the panel datasheet value; the SSD1306 formula gives 470–560k.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave R12 on one 0402 footprint and tune for brightness.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Panel glass is 26.7 mm wide: it sits in the optics cartridge; only the FPC

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reaches this board. Winstar alternate: confirm its 30-pin map first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BMI270 ASDx/ASCx: leave open or tie to VDDIO, never to GND.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The IMU sits on the optics, not the battery: mount it rigidly

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and record its offset from the display (binocular hook).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One I2C bus: BMI270 0x68, VEML7700 0x10, MAX17048 0x36 (puck).
